$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFHV (AIP France, chart dated 2026-03-19): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Villefranche - Tarare

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
Possible IFR operations.
Simultaneous use of RWY prohibited.
Unpaved runway reserved for home-based ACFT according to local instructions.
TKOF and LDG delayed when a glider is holding on the unpaved RWY at less than a half width RWY of common limit.
Aerobatics prohibited on AD.
Uneven ground and bumps on airfield shoulders.
Unpaved RWY 18L/36R unusable after heavy rainfalls.
Ground traffic: Give priority to exiting via TWY S and entering via TWY N.
TWY N restricted to ACFT whose main landing gear overall width is below 3.5 m.
Unpaved RWY: evacuation and penetration front of TWY N.
Apron C reserved for visiting ACFT.
ACFT: Comply with published patterns as far as possible.
Avoid repeated patterns, especially: During WE and public HOL,.
Every day between 1100 and 1300 (SUM: -1 HR).
Avoid overflying built up area Alix, 1,5 km ESE from AD.
AD réservé aux ACFT munis de radio.
Activité IFR possible.
Utilisation simultanée des pistes interdite.

TKOF et LDG suspendus si un planeur est immobilisé sur la piste non revêtue à moins d'une demi-largeur de piste de la limite commune.
Voltige interdite sur l'AD.
Piste non revêtue 18L/36R inutilisable après de fortes précipitations.

PRKG C réservé aux ACFT de passage.
VILLEFRANCHE TARARE HELICOPTERES : Respecter les circuits publiés dans la mesure du possible.
Éviter les tours de piste répétitifs, en particulier : Les week-ends et JF.
Tous les jours entre 1100 et 1300 (ETE : - 1 HR).
